construction:
certificate_v5: complete fixed-right-kernel sums (standalone; supersedes v2-v4).

For a right kernel T and optional excluded element x0:
  G(T,x0) = { {L | T u B} : L in A(H_L(T)), req(T) dominated by L,
                            B in A(V(dom L)),  x0 notin B }
  H_L(T) = safe_left(T);  V_max = {g notin T : g || T};  req(g) = maximal left options of g;
  REQ = U req(g) (g in T u V_max);  dom(L) = {q in REQ : q <= some l in L};
  V(D) = {g in V_max : every q in req(g) is <= some d in D}.
Safety: left options of L are hit by T (H_L); every left option of every r in T u V(dom L) is <= some
q in dom(L), hence <= some l in L.  Each (L,B) is counted once (dom L is a function of L).
|G| = sum_D e(D) c(D),  e(D) = #{L : dom(L) = D},  c(D) = #{B in A(V(D)) : x0 notin B}.
Families: G1 = G([0,3,12,21], -), G2 = G([0,3,12], 21), and mirrors -G1, -G2.
Disjoint: G1/G2 by 21 in R; every L dominates 2 > 0 so 0 notin L while mirror lefts contain -0 = 0.
